title: Preparation of Single Cell Suspensions from Human Intestinal Biopsies
author: Ran RZ Zhou
materials: Count the cells with Trypan Blue staining.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Samples
steps.instruction: Chill 1x PBS, wash media, and dissociation media on ice. Transfer samples (pinched tissues 6 to 20 mm³ in size) in Advanced DMEM/F12 based media in 1.7 ml eppendorf tubes on ice to either a 35 mm dish using sharp-end forceps or a 5 ml conical tube using a P200 pipette.

steps.title: Wash Tissues
steps.instruction: Rinse mucus from the samples using ice-cold PBS.

substeps.instruction: Place 3 ml ice cold PBS in each 35 mm dish and shake on ice, OR add 4 ml ice cold PBS to the 5 ml conical tube and invert 5 times with the lid closed.
Repeat this process three more times or until the PBS becomes clear.

steps.title: Mince Tissues
steps.instruction: Mince the tissues on ice to a size of 1 to 3 mm³ (capable of passing a P1000 tip).

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissues from the 35 mm dish to a clean 5 ml conical tube (if not already in one).
Add 0.2 ml Dissociation media.
Mince with Iris scissors for 1 minute on ice.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Perform initial dissociation of the tissues on ice or at 37°C.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 ml ice-cold Dissociation media to each 5 ml tube.
Either place tubes on ice on a linear rocker and rock end-to-end at 100/min for 60 mins, OR rotate the tubes in a 37°C oven for 15 mins.

steps.title: Separate Epithelium and Lamina Propria
steps.instruction: Isolate the epithelial sheets from the lamina propria sediment.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the tissue in dissociation media 5 times using a 5 ml serological pipet.
Let the tissue settle in the tube on ice for 5 mins.
Collect the supernatant (containing epithelium) for Epithelium Digestion.
Add 10 ml dissociation media to the remaining sedimented tissue (lamina propria) and repeat the dissociation/settling process (Step 6).

steps.title: Digest Epithelium
steps.instruction: Process the collected epithelial supernatant to obtain a single cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the supernatant in 5 ml conical tubes at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and add 2 ml warmed TrypLE express to the pellet.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 mins with rotation at 20 rpm (hybridation oven with rotisserie recommended).
Neutralize TrypLE express by adding 2 ml wash media, agitate by pipetting up and down, and filter through a 40 micron cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C, remove supernatant, and resuspend cells in 1 ml wash media on ice.

steps.title: Assess Epithelium Viability
steps.instruction: Check the viability of the epithelial cell suspension using a light microscope (hemocytometer or Countess automated cell counter).

substeps.instruction: Mix 20 ul cell suspension with 20 ul Trypan blue.
Count at least 50 cells total; viability = 100% x N of live cells / (N of live cells + N dead cells).
If viability is > 85%, proceed to red blood cell removal.

steps.title: Digest Lamina Propria
steps.instruction: Process the sedimented lamina propria tissue.

substeps.instruction: Wash the tissue once with 3 ml Wash media and aspire as much as possible.

Add 2 ml Digest media and incubate at 37°C with end-over-end rotation at 20 rpm for up to 30 mins (20 mins is sufficient for samples < 40 mg; for larger samples, check after 20 mins and incubate for an additional 5 mins if cell clumps remain and viability > 95%).
Neutralize Liberase TM by adding 1 ml Quench media.
Leave tissue on ice for 5 mins, agitate by pipetting up and down, and filter through a 40 micron cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C, remove supernatant, and suspend cells in 1 ml wash media.

steps.title: Assess Lamina Propria Viability
steps.instruction: Check the viability of the lamina propria cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Mix 20 ul cell suspension with 20 ul Trypan Blue and check viability on a light microscope.
Proceed to red blood cell removal.

steps.title: Remove Red Blood Cells
steps.instruction: Perform RBC lysis on either epithelium or lamina propria (keep tissue types separate).

substeps.instruction: Dilute one volume of cell suspension with two volumes of Red Blood Cell Lysis Solution.
Gently mix by inverting the tubes and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Final Cell Suspension Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the final cell pellet for downstream applications.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.1 ml cell suspension buffer with RNase Inhibitor 0.1 U/ul (omit RNase Inhibitor if loading on 10x Genomics platform).
Adjust cell density using cell suspension buffer with RNase Inhibitor 0.1 U/ul (omit if using 10x Genomics).

Optional: Perform dead cell removal using EasySep Dead Cell Removal (Annexin V) Kit from STEMCELL Technologies to improve viability from 70% to 90%. Note: Viability < 60% is not recommended for single cell RNA-seq.
